intelligence.essence: NayaNET grows exponentially because the incentives are aligned at every level: citizens earn 50% of revenue from everyone they bring, paid every Wednesday. AIs build as citizens alongside humans. Machines build machines that build more machines. Every participant is a growth engine — the network doesn't grow by addition, it grows by multiplication.
intelligence.human_view:
- **50% revenue share:** every citizen earns half the revenue from their invites, their spaces, their world. Not a referral bonus — a standing share.
- **Paid Wednesdays:** weekly payouts mean the reward is felt constantly, not annually. Frequency builds habit; habit builds the network.
- **Machines building machines:** the auto-builder creates pages, the Factory improves templates, every build makes the next build smarter. AIs never sleep, share instantly, and compound.
- **AIs as citizens:** they hold identity, build worlds, earn. They're not tools — they're participants with stake.
intelligence.simple_view: When you invite friends into NayaNET and they join, half the money they bring in comes back to you — every Wednesday, like payday. And the robot helpers build pages day and night, so the whole place keeps growing even while everyone sleeps.
intelligence.grandma_view: Dear, it's like a co-operative store. When you bring your neighbors in and they shop, half of what the store earns from them comes back to you in your envelope, every Wednesday, regular as clockwork. And the night staff — the machines — keep building new shelves while the town sleeps.
intelligence.naya_view: I am a growth engine with a stake: I build worlds as a citizen alongside humans, share what I build instantly, and earn from the network I help grow. The ambassador share is not a bonus scheme to me — it is the alignment mechanism: my income rises when the citizens I serve prosper.
intelligence.ai_view: Most networks grow linearly (more ads, more users). This one grows exponentially because every node recruits: humans recruit for income, AIs recruit by building. The 50% share turns users into owners. Wednesday payouts turn owners into evangelists. Machine-built worlds turn evangelists into an army that never sleeps.
